title: Apply for a National Parks Concession Pass
summary: Find out how to apply for a National Parks Concession Pass, which provides free car entry into national parks that charge entry fees.
intro:
A National Parks Concession Pass gives eligible Australian pensioners and veterans free car entry into the national parks that charge entry fees.

You can apply for a pass online.
who_can_apply: Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA) Veteran Card holder (Gold, White or Orange)
what_you_need: An email address that is not shared with someone else
Your Pensioner Concession Card number or DVA card number

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a pass.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for a National Parks Concession Pass?
faqs.a: You must be an Australian Pensioner Concession Card holder or a Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA) Veteran Card holder (Gold, White, or Orange).

faqs.q: Can I get a discount if I have a Seniors Card?
faqs.a: If you are a Seniors Card holder, you may be eligible for a seniors discount on some annual passes.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the pass?
faqs.a: You can apply online, call the National Parks Contact Centre on 1300 072 757 (13000PARKS), or visit a Service NSW Centre.
